cohort: Pregnant women with active COVID-19 or a history of COVID-19 during their second or third trimesters, admitted to a South Florida hospital between March 2020 and December 2021, excluding those aged less than 18 or greater than 40.
finding: Compared to national data, overall pregnancy-related complication rates were lower in COVID-19-positive pregnant women.
mod_finding: Among COVID-19-positive pregnant women, the cesarean section rate was 47.62% and the vaginal delivery rate was 52.38%.
